audience: managers who roster staff and approve timesheets and leave in Deputy

useCases.title: See who is rostered and in which area
useCases.text: The AI searches shifts by time window, employee, area and published or open state. You see who works when, and which shifts are still open.

useCases.title: Find timesheets that wait for approval
useCases.text: The AI searches timesheets by time window, employee, area and approval state, and reads one with its breaks. You see hours and cost per timesheet.

useCases.title: Check leave requests, or record leave and unavailability
useCases.text: The AI lists leave requests by status, employee and dates. It can add a leave request for an employee or record a time they cannot work.

useCases.title: Check availability, then create and publish shifts
useCases.text: The AI checks an employee's unavailability, adds a shift as a draft or open shift, and publishes drafts with the notification you choose.

useCases.title: Correct and approve a timesheet
useCases.text: The AI reads a timesheet, corrects its start, end, area or meal break, and approves it as a supervisor. Approved timesheets go toward payroll export.

useCases.title: Post a memo to a location's news feed
useCases.text: The AI posts a memo, optionally asking staff to confirm they read it, or aimed at chosen locations or users. Staff see it at once.
